The teaching materials on this site are all built with Quarto. Each course pairs
slide decks with hands-on labs, and everything lives under the **Teaching** tab
so you can go from setup to a working environment then straight into a course.

## Setup

Before any course, get a fresh machine ready with the step-by-step guides:

- [Setup · common](setup/setup-common.qmd): install R, Positron, and the core R packages, plus optional Positron extensions and a version check.
- [Setup · Reproducible Workflows](setup/setup-rr.qmd): Quarto, Python (uv/uvr), git/Happy Git, Posit Connect, and the `{pins}`/`{vetiver}` tooling.

## Courses and workshops

| Course | Language | Sessions | Where |
|---|---|---|---|
| [The R Statistical Language](r-statistical-language/index.qmd) | R (base → tidyverse) | 3 | this site |
| [Reproducible Workflows](reproducible-workflows/index.qmd) | Quarto (R + Python) | 3 | this site |
| [Data Science with R](data-science-with-r/index.qmd) | R | 8 parts + 3 EDA | this site |
| [Futureverse](https://astamm.github.io/futureverse/) | R | 1 | own repo |
| [Parallel Rcpp](https://astamm.github.io/parallel-rcpp/) | C++ / Rcpp | 1 | own repo |
| [Serverless interactive reporting](https://astamm.github.io/shinylive-quarto/) | Quarto / Shiny | 1 | own repo |

The two ENSAI courses are taught over three 3-hour sessions each. Data Science
with R is a longer slide-and-exercise collection. The other three are one-off
workshops or slide collections still hosted in their own repositories while
they are being folded into this site.
